I must assume one of them has been opened nearby.    Seraf is supposed to be visiting soon. How can I face him? I spilled the blood of my kin across the stone the other day, on Mercia's order. I remember...a gildless. He could barely float. Baraq caught him trying to teleport away. His blood stains my armor still.  Why wasn't Orestes there to save him?
